answers.core: This serves to help people recognize that there is a problem with the structure of their scene which they would not otherwise be aware of. If it was an add-on, they would have to know the limitation of the clipping system even exists to go and search for an add-on to notify them about it - and at that point, they already know about the limitation, so its usefulness is much more limited.
answers.workaround: I'm not aware of how this would be implemented via scripts, much less a just "few lines".
